actions.Equip: allowlisted weapon string or {weapon:string}; empty string unequips
actions.Dash: optional direction Vector3; server validates and determines distance
actions.Gender: one of the original Male/Female/Fembxy strings; session preference for requester only

authority: Server owns targets, damage, cooldowns, downing, executions, carry, awakening and voting.
ordering: State.revision and animationRevision reject stale snapshots and animation messages.
snapshot: {version,serverTime,states,voting,weather}; states include gender and current animation; no client credentials are gameplay authorization.
chatEmotes: Emote accepts wave/point/dance/dance1/dance2/dance3/laugh/cheer; the server selects an original variant and publishes chat/name/index.
